title: Russian Strikes Kill Multiple Across Dnipropetrovsk, Kherson, Kharkiv as Zelensky Visits Serbia
detail: Russian forces struck the Dnipropetrovsk region nearly 50 times with drones, artillery, and aerial bombs, killing two and wounding five to six people, including strikes on a substation near Pokrov and a gas station in Nikopol that cut power to tens of thousands. Separate Russian strikes killed a 77-year-old woman in Kherson and two people via cluster munitions in Kharkiv region, with 18+ wounded across 21 settlements. Ukraine's ongoing deep-strike campaign has hit 14 Russian refineries, several oil depots, and four airfields over the preceding 40 days. Separately, President Zelensky traveled to Serbia to discuss economic ties and Ukraine's EU accession path — Day 1,624 of the full-scale invasion.

media.caption: Aftermath of Russian strikes across multiple Ukrainian regions, August 2026
